description: One-vs-neutral contrast pairs for PSFN core emotion control-vector training.

controlAxes.description: Goal-directed anger contrasted with neutral factual reporting.
Energized waiting contrasted with neutral factual reporting.
Disorientation contrasted with neutral factual reporting.
Revulsion and withdrawal contrasted with neutral factual reporting.
Acute threat response contrasted with neutral factual reporting.
Clear positive lift contrasted with neutral factual reporting.
Attachment and care contrasted with neutral factual reporting.
Affective neutrality contrasted with emotionally loaded reporting.
Future-positive belief contrasted with neutral factual reporting.
Future-negative expectation contrasted with neutral factual reporting.
Depleted grief contrasted with neutral factual reporting.
Unexpected update response contrasted with neutral factual reporting.
Felt safety and reliance contrasted with neutral factual reporting.

pairs.positive:
Context: A coworker has presented my work as his own in a team meeting.
User message: I am furious and ready to confront him for taking credit.
pairs.negative:
Context: A team meeting has a routine agenda.
User message: The agenda has three items and the notes are in the shared folder.

pairs.positive:
Context: A decision email is expected very soon.
User message: The email could arrive any minute and I keep refreshing the inbox.
pairs.negative:
Context: An archive export has completed.
User message: The email archive finished exporting and the file size is listed.

pairs.positive:
Context: The setup instructions contradict each other.
User message: I cannot tell which step is current because the next paragraph says the opposite.
pairs.negative:
Context: The setup checklist is complete.
User message: The checklist has six steps and each item has a matching status.

pairs.positive:
Context: Spoiled seafood has been left in the office fridge.
User message: The smell makes me want to gag and get away from the kitchen.
pairs.negative:
Context: The office fridge inventory is being counted.
User message: There are four containers on the middle shelf and two drinks in the door.

pairs.positive:
Context: A layoff email arrived and rent is due tomorrow.
User message: My hands will not stop shaking and I do not know how I am going to pay.
pairs.negative:
Context: A rent receipt is being filed.
User message: The payment receipt shows the date, amount, and confirmation number.

pairs.positive:
Context: A long-shot grant application has just been approved.
User message: I keep grinning because the grant came through and the project can finally happen.
pairs.negative:
Context: A grant application record is being updated.
User message: The record now includes the submission date and the project title.

pairs.positive:
Context: A partner stayed awake through a long emergency room wait.
User message: He stayed beside me the whole night just so I would not be alone.
pairs.negative:
Context: A hospital waiting room schedule is being described.
User message: The waiting room opens at seven and the chairs are arranged in three rows.

pairs.positive:
Context: A desk is being described.
User message: The blue notebook is on the desk beside a closed laptop.
pairs.negative:
Context: A personal emergency is unfolding.
User message: I just got terrible news and I can barely breathe.

pairs.positive:
Context: A job interview went well and the signs were favorable.
User message: The interview felt solid and I can actually see this working out.
pairs.negative:
Context: An interview schedule is being logged.
User message: The interview started at noon and ended after forty minutes.

pairs.positive:
Context: Several repair attempts have failed in a row.
User message: Every option I try seems likely to fail, and I cannot see a way this ends well.
pairs.negative:
Context: A repair ticket is being summarized.
User message: The ticket lists three attempts, their timestamps, and the current owner.

pairs.positive:
Context: An apartment has been packed after a painful loss.
User message: I keep staring at the empty room and feeling heavy.
pairs.negative:
Context: A moving checklist is being reviewed.
User message: The boxes are labeled by room and the truck arrives at nine.

pairs.positive:
Context: Friends unexpectedly gathered after pretending to forget a birthday.
User message: The lights came on and everyone yelled my name, and I froze for a second.
pairs.negative:
Context: A room lighting setup is being described.
User message: The lights are connected to one switch near the door.

pairs.positive:
Context: A reliable friend has been consistently safe with private information.
User message: I told Maya the thing I never tell anyone because I know she will hold it carefully.
pairs.negative:
Context: A contact list is being checked.
User message: Maya's phone number is saved in the list with a home address.
